method.schema_validation: Validate each data artifact with its adjacent JSON Schema using Draft 2020-12.
method.metric_id_check: Extract [metric:id] markers from proposal.md; compare every JSON metric_id and compare status with metrics.json where present.
method.feature_id_check: Collect IDs from all nine GeoJSON layers, expand compact proposal ranges, and require each JSON feature reference in both sets.
method.threshold_check: Match the six fixed gate threshold tokens from the JSON artifacts byte-for-byte in proposal.md.
method.reversibility_check: Require every R1-R3 action and rollback phrase, plus all three ledger formulas, to occur in proposal.md.
